subject: acc-ft
title: ACC.FT.------INFO.DY.
description: Second diagram on page 113 (ALT(FT)II-7), paired with AFTD × MT-INFO above. The following prose names the structural target this crossing diagrams: 'the emergence of the multi-instrumentalist-composer is directly related to the realness of new functionalism. To understand this development is to have insight into the progressional continuum of this time zone.' ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism — the form's actual accelerated working) crossed with INFO-DY (information dynamics — the partner-axis's working information-dynamics). ACC-FT sits at lower-left with the subject-arrow; EXT-FT (extended functionalism) at top-center and INFO-DY at upper-right, with T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), POL-OR (political order) and RT-DY (reality dynamics) on the right. WO-CH (world change) at upper-left. REL-TECH (relevant technology) sits centrally, with PER-TRS (perceived transition) and PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) to its right. TH-CONT-DY (thrust-continuance dynamics) at the bottom-center. Structural argument: when accelerated-functionalism is crossed with information-dynamics, WO-CH branches from the main line, with EXT-FT branching from the WO-CH line. T-C-IMP branches from the main line toward the right, with RT-DY branching from the T-C-IMP line and POL-OR from the RT-DY line. A vertical drops from the main line to TH-CONT-DY; PROJ-DY branches from that vertical, PER-TRS from the PROJ-DY line, and REL-TECH from the PER-TRS line.
